                               ORDINANCE

   / r ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION I . Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols

and indications as shown on Map No. 15-M in the area bounded by


       West Haft Street; North Milwaukee Avenue; a line 50 feet southeast
       of and parallel to West Haft Street; and the alley next southwest of
       and parallel to North Milwaukee Avenue,


to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.




Common address of property:         6320-6324 North Milwaukee Avenue

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicanf is proposing to establish three (3)

13.   Describe the proposed use ofthe property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling unit number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC): The Applicant is proposing
      to establish three (3) residential units on the second floor of the existing two-storv building.

      phvsical expansions of the existing building are proposed. The building will remain two-
      stories in height. Three (3) surface parking spaces will be located at the rear of the subiect
      lot to support the three (3) proposed residential units.
